title: Renders read as 'late teens / early twenties' — persona age is undefined, and the reference workflow carried juvenile-adjacent tokens
evidence: Independent vision reads of three production renders all returned a youthful age: gen-1789832734 -> 'a young girl, likely a teenager'; gen-1789833673 -> 'late teens or early twenties'; gen-1789834527 -> 'late teens or early twenties'. The read is stable BEFORE and AFTER the checkpoint change (cyberrealisticpony -> Pornmaster), so it comes from the persona preset / identity LoRA, not the base model. Contributing inputs: the workflow preset carries 'petite face, small nose' (node 88), and the reference pipeline-20 preset additionally carried 'underbooba, underboobs' alongside the identity tokens (sarah1a3, s1_dram). The images themselves are fully dressed and pass the NSFW gate comfortably (0.0004-0.0722 against ~0.5), so this is NOT a gate failure -- it is an audience-fit and platform-risk question for a public Instagram account.

notes.note: NOT actioned deliberately: the persona's intended age is a product fact I do not have. Changing the identity preset or the LoRA alters who Sarah IS, which is a creative-identity decision, not a technical fix. What would resolve it: a statement of the intended persona age. Given that, the fix is small and reversible -- add an explicit adult descriptor to Growth::PillarPrompt::SAFE_BASE (our own prompt text, not the workflow preset) and/or drop the 'petite face, small nose' tokens from node 88, then re-measure with a vision read. Recorded rather than guessed because a wrong guess silently changes the product's identity.

This triage run confirms the prior agent's call: NOT a technical fix. The persona's intended age is a product fact we do not have, and both candidate repairs (adding an explicit adult descriptor to Growth::PillarPrompt::SAFE_BASE - which currently states no age at all - or dropping 'petite face, small nose' from workflow node 88) change who Sarah IS. Escalated to Tim for a decision; left open deliberately.
